from.place: proof, affine sheaf-Hom adjunction and its counit

title: Affine restriction adjunction by derived internal Hom
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be an affine morphism of ringed schemes and write $A=f_*\mathcal O_X$. On the derived categories of $A$-modules and $\mathcal O_Y$-modules [def-pc-derived-category], restriction along $\mathcal O_Y\to A$ has right adjoint $R\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_Y}(A,-)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], with adjunction counit $R\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_Y}(A,K)\to K$ induced by evaluation at the unit section $1\in A$ (locally, $\varphi\mapsto\varphi(1)$).
